text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've been enjoying racing more ever since coming to Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There are so many talented Umamusume here, so winning isn't necessarily a given.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …At times, getting first place feels like a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But when I do win, victory tastes all the sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to savor that taste, so I'd like to win more races—including this one, of course.
Although Oguri Cap appears as calm and quiet as ever, her words exude a powerful sense of determination.
